description:
Find homes in England and Wales by street, postcode, town or address. Each row has
the home's last sale, freehold or leasehold, whether it is owner-occupied, whether it
is listed for sale, and its response likelihood (High = listed for sale and
owner-occupied, Medium = owner-occupied, Unknown = no record). Filter with
`response_likelihood` to answer "which homes on this street are owner-occupied and for
sale", or sort by it. Returns 20 per page (`limit`, up to 60), newest sale first by default.
If the street name exists in several places the answer lists the places as `streets`
instead of rows; ask the person which one, then search again with the town or postcode.
When nothing matches exactly the answer says so (`exact_match` false) and gives at most
ten of the nearest names, which may be in other towns: Scotland and Northern Ireland are
not covered.

limit.description: Addresses per page: 20 by default, up to 60. Ask for fewer when one home is wanted.
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Street, postcode, outcode, town or full address, as a person would type it: 'Merton Road, SW19', 'BS7 8', 'Ash Street, Salford M6', '41 Denning Road NW3'.
query.title: Query

response_likelihood.description: Only homes with this response likelihood. 'High' = listed for sale and owner-occupied (the homes where a letter reaches an owner who is selling). 'Medium' = owner-occupied, not listed for sale. 'Unknown' = no public record that the owner lives there. 'Owner on GetMovely' = the owner has claimed the address. Leave out for all homes.
response_likelihood.title: Response Likelihood

sale_pairs.description: Filter to homes whose sale history contains these sales, each as 'price:year', e.g. ['450000:2019']. This is how to find the exact address behind a listing or an advert that shows past sales.
sale_pairs.title: Sale Pairs

sort.description: 'recent' newest sale first (default); 'likelihood' High first, then Medium, then the rest; 'price_desc' / 'price_asc' by last sale price; 'addr' by address.
sort.title: Sort

name: search_addresses
title: Search addresses
